message:
`<div>` with a keydown handler must have an ARIA role
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_static_element_interactions

Using `on:keydown` to listen to the keydown event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onkeydown` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `<slot>` to render parent content is deprecated. Use `{@render ...}` tags instead
https://svelte.dev/e/slot_element_deprecated
